messages:
anya: Heads-up — found a cluster of synthetic-anchor collisions after the deid pass. A few golden rows now share the same anchor_id + deid fingerprint, likely from synth pipeline v2.3. This could contaminate the golden set. :warning:
marcos: Ugh. Can you drop a couple examples so I can repro locally?
anya: Examples pasted below (sample ids and short notes):
```
anchor_id: a-synth-4123, src_id: ingest-2026-03-18-07, note: mask-prob 0.2
anchor_id: a-synth-4123, src_id: ing-dup-904, note: deid-token mismatch after mask
anchor_id: a-synth-9988, src_id: ing-2026-03-17-11, note: identical anchor text post-deid
```
tj: I'll kick off a dedupe pass over samplebank-synth with the anchor+deid fingerprint. Command I'm using: `./bin/curate dedupe --scope samplebank-synth --fingerprint anchor,deid --window 14d`
labeler-bot: dedupe job queued (job id dq-6742). Estimated runtime ~8m. Will post results when finished.
sophia: Please hold any golden refresh/rollouts until we confirm the golden set is clean. Can we add a temporary gating rule: block golden promotion if anchor collision rate > 0.5% for the batch?
priya: I'll stand up a small audit labeling campaign for suspect golden rows and assign to 3 labelers. Need to reserve labeling slots — @ops can you confirm?
marcos: Also run a quick embedding-sim check to capture near-duplicates that simple fingerprints miss: `python tools/scan_sim.py --index samplebank --pattern 'a-synth-*' --topk 5 --metric cosine`
anya: Noted — I also looked at synth PRs. PR #1324 changed token masking during synth rollout; that lines up with timestamp of first collisions.
tj: dedupe finished. Summary: 42 candidate duplicates found in golden_anchors, 28 removed from active golden set and moved to quarantine. Full report: s3://redwood-curation/reports/dedupe/1742167890.json
sophia: Nice. Priya, please share campaign id + expected QC completion time. We'll keep the block until QC passes.
priya: Audit campaign id gc-981 created. Labelers assigned: emma, jason, li. ETA EOD for first pass. Will post QC metrics to this thread when done. :thumbsup:
marcos: If audit confirms false positives, we should refine the fingerprint to include normalized deid tokens (strip <NAME>/<EMAIL> markers). I'll draft a patch for the fingerprinting lib.
anya: Quick checklist for follow-up: 1) keep golden refresh blocked 2) attach dedupe report to the GC ticket 3) run embedding-sim scan (marcos) 4) finish audit campaign (priya) 5) revert or patch PR #1324 if audit implicates synth change. Ping me for blockers.
labeler-bot: quarantine bucket updated: s3://redwood-curation/quarantine/golden/1742167890/ (42 rows).
tj: posted small patch to fingerprint lib in my fork, will open an RFC if audit shows it's needed.
sophia: Thanks all — this was fast. Once audit passes, we'll schedule a controlled golden refresh (canary first). Keep updates here.
